_comment: BASENet-3 non-causal, paper-reproduction architecture (arXiv:2606.12662, PESQ 3.55 target). Widths solved against the paper's four published numbers (causal 0.81M/7.1G, non-causal 0.83M/7.3G): per-bin shared GRU (the only CRN wiring consistent with the paper's tiny bi->uni deltas), CRN at 100 freq bins (2x AvgPool, not the old 12.6x adaptive pool to 16), compute moved from the GRU into full-res convs (C=44). Fig.1-faithful: per-band stems, no fusion IR block, no decoder skip (unnecessary at 100-bin bottleneck). This config: 0.830M / 7.55G. Train with --accum_steps 2 for the paper's effective batch 8.
